name: LanDeng Chinese Incense Terminology (Chinese–English)
description: Canonical Chinese–English terminology for Chinese botanical incense, compiled by LanDeng (澜灯). Chinese terms are the source of truth; English is the agreed translation. One Chinese word does not always map to one English word.
changelog: Phase 4: added 20 terms (215 -> 235) across incense forms (香饼/香膏), scent space & ritual (薰衣/衣香), modern market grading (食用级/香用级), classical 香谱 residue (木香/郁金/艾纳香/白胶香), and deepened entity-page terms (当归/灵猫香/海狸香/紫草茸/秘鲁香脂/阿魏/白及/罗勒/砂仁/山柰).

mainEntity.name: 本香
mainEntity.description: 本香 — the body / main note, the sustained character of a scent.

mainEntity.name: 尾香
mainEntity.description: 尾香 — the tail / dry-down note that lingers after the burn.

mainEntity.name: 金丝结

mainEntity.name: 机制冰片

mainEntity.name: 甘松
mainEntity.description: 甘松 — spikenard, an aromatic herb root used as a minister or assistant ingredient in 合香.

mainEntity.name: 苏合香
mainEntity.description: 苏合香 — storax, a balsamic resin noted in the classical manuals.

mainEntity.name: 香附子
mainEntity.description: 香附子 — cyperus (purple nutsedge) tuber, a specialist 合香 herb.

mainEntity.name: 雀头香
mainEntity.description: 雀头香 — 'sparrow-head incense', a classical alternate name for 香附子.

mainEntity.name: 莎草根
mainEntity.description: 莎草根 — 'sedge root', a classical alternate name for 香附子.

mainEntity.name: 玛蹄脂
mainEntity.description: 玛蹄脂 — mastic, the aromatic resin of Pistacia lentiscus.

mainEntity.name: 香脂
mainEntity.description: 香脂 — incense resin; dried gum-resin burned or heated (香脂 / 香片).

mainEntity.name: 香云
mainEntity.description: 香云 — the fragrant cloud of smoke; classical texts describe burning a pellet of incense as raising a great fragrant cloud (起大香云).

mainEntity.name: 烟直
mainEntity.description: 烟直 — straight-rising smoke; a prized ritual sign, as with 降真香, whose smoke 'rises straight' (烧烟直上) to invoke the spirits.

mainEntity.name: 灰白
mainEntity.description: 灰白 — white ash; a classical quality test — material that 'burns to white ash is best' (烧之灰白者好), recorded for 苏合香 and 安息香.

mainEntity.name: 结香
mainEntity.description: 结香 — resin formation; how agarwood coalesces — the resin 'gathers and forms fragrance' (结成香) over years of wounding and soaking.

mainEntity.name: 余烬
mainEntity.description: 余烬 — the remaining embers and ash after incense has burned; classical usage records taking 'the remaining embers' (取余烬). In safety practice, extinguish fully and never leave embers smoldering.

mainEntity.name: 灰冷
mainEntity.description: 灰冷 — the ash after it has cooled (烧过灰冷); in safety practice, let charcoal and ash cool fully in the heatproof vessel before disposal.

mainEntity.name: 香方
mainEntity.description: 香方 — a classical Chinese incense recipe; a structured formula for a compound incense (合香) that names ingredients, proportions, and processing, recorded in the canonical manuals (香谱) — e.g. 范煜《和香方》.

mainEntity.name: 香药
mainEntity.description: 香药 — 'aromatic medicine'; an aromatic used both as a spice and in traditional medicine, and as an incense ingredient — e.g. 砂仁, 草果, 阿魏.

mainEntity.name: 修合
mainEntity.description: 修合 — compounding; the preparation of a formula — classical manuals are described as being largely 修合香方 (compounded fragrance formulas).

mainEntity.name: 分两
mainEntity.description: 分两 — weights and proportions; a recipe's quantities, 'divided and weighed evenly' (分两相匀) — the reliable content of a recipe, read as ratios rather than exact grams.

mainEntity.name: 加减
mainEntity.description: 加减 — to add or reduce; adjusting a formula's quantities — classical recipes direct one to 'add or reduce water' (加减水) or 'use honey, adding or reducing as needed' (白蜜加减用).

mainEntity.name: 蜜香
mainEntity.description: 蜜香 — 'honey fragrance'; the Jiao-region name for agarwood, so called because 'its qi is like honeycomb' (其气如蜜脾).

mainEntity.name: 鸡骨香
mainEntity.description: 鸡骨香 — 'chicken-bone fragrance'; a shape-named agarwood grade (因形而名) for pieces with a hollow, bone-like center; also a classical alias of 降真香.

mainEntity.name: 青桂香
mainEntity.description: 青桂香 — 'green-cassia fragrance'; one of the eight fragrances said to come from a single agarwood tree, listed in 《南番香录》.

mainEntity.name: 马蹄香
mainEntity.description: 马蹄香 — 'horse-hoof fragrance'; a shape-named agarwood grade listed among the eight fragrances of one tree.

mainEntity.name: 鸡舌香
mainEntity.description: 鸡舌香 — 'chicken-tongue fragrance'; a classical name for clove (丁香), also listed among the eight agarwood fragrances.

mainEntity.name: 叶子香
mainEntity.description: 叶子香 — 'leaf fragrance'; a thin grade of 栈香 (栈香之薄者), also called 龙鳞香, said to surpass 栈香 in fragrance.

mainEntity.name: 蓬莱香
mainEntity.description: 蓬莱香 — 'Penglai fragrance'; agarwood pieces as large as a rain-hat (大如笠者).

mainEntity.name: 煎香
mainEntity.description: 煎香 — 'decocted fragrance'; half-formed agarwood still attached to its wood (连木者), also called 婆菜香 / 弄水香.

mainEntity.name: 弄水香
mainEntity.description: 弄水香 — 'water-stirring fragrance'; a half-formed agarwood grade (半结半不结), foreign name 婆菜香.

mainEntity.name: 水盘香
mainEntity.description: 水盘香 — 'water-basin fragrance'; agarwood from a tree that has died of its own accord (自枯死者).

mainEntity.name: 重漏
mainEntity.description: 重漏 — 'heavy-leak'; a lower agarwood grade, ranked below 海南栈香 alongside 生结 (海南栈香之下又有重漏生结等香皆下色).

mainEntity.name: 白眼香
mainEntity.description: 白眼香 — 'white-eye fragrance'; an alternate name for 黄熟香 (白眼香亦黄熟之别名), lighter in color and not used in medicine but in blending.

mainEntity.name: 龙鳞香
mainEntity.description: 龙鳞香 — 'dragon-scale fragrance'; an alternate name for 叶子香 (叶子香一名龙鳞香).

mainEntity.name: 光香
mainEntity.description: 光香 — 'bright fragrance'; agarwood that resembles mountain-rock deadwood (山石枯槎者).

mainEntity.name: 降真香
mainEntity.description: 降真香 — 'descending-truth fragrance'; a resinous heartwood burned in Daoist ritual so its smoke rises straight to summon the immortals; classical alias 紫藤香 / 鸡骨香.

mainEntity.name: 真腊
mainEntity.description: 真腊 — Chenla (present-day Cambodia); in classical grading, the highest-ranked agarwood origin — 'of the regions agarwood comes from, Chenla is first' (真腊者为上).

mainEntity.name: 占城
mainEntity.description: 占城 — Champa (central Vietnam); ranked second after Chenla as an agarwood origin (占城次之).

mainEntity.name: 渤泥
mainEntity.description: 渤泥 — Borneo; ranked lowest of the three classical agarwood origins (渤泥最下).

mainEntity.name: 三佛齐
mainEntity.description: 三佛齐 — Srivijaya (Palembang); a classical origin for benzoin (安息香) recorded in the materia medica.

mainEntity.name: 番香
mainEntity.description: 番香 — 'foreign fragrance'; a general classical term for imported incense; 番香 is also called 番沉, from Borneo and Srivijaya.

mainEntity.name: 海南香
mainEntity.description: 海南香 — 'Hainan fragrance'; agarwood from Hainan, long regarded as the aromatic benchmark of Chinese trade.

mainEntity.name: 安南香
mainEntity.description: 安南香 — 'Annam fragrance'; Vietnamese agarwood, historically ranked alongside Hainan as the benchmark.

mainEntity.name: 样品
mainEntity.description: 样品 — a sample; in wholesale buying, a sample verifies the product (not the supplier) and should be pulled by the buyer, not chosen by the supplier.

mainEntity.name: 批次
mainEntity.description: 批次 — a batch or lot; batch-to-batch consistency (批次一致性) is the hidden risk in bulk botanical incense.

mainEntity.name: 原产地
mainEntity.description: 原产地 — country of origin; wholesale packaging should carry correct country-of-origin marks.

mainEntity.name: 麝香檀
mainEntity.description: 麝香檀 — 'musk-sandalwood'; a fragrant wood (西山桦根) burned like 煎香, also called 麝檀香.

mainEntity.name: 婆菜香
mainEntity.description: 婆菜香 — a foreign name for 弄水香 / 煎香, the half-formed agarwood grade.

mainEntity.name: 清
mainEntity.description: 清 — clear / pure; a bright, clean fragrance character with no muddiness or heaviness (香乘: 清芬韵度 'clear-fragrance character').

mainEntity.name: 甜
mainEntity.description: 甜 — sweet; a honeyed, sugary aroma facet, one of the primary 品香 descriptors (香乘: 香甜如蜜).

mainEntity.name: 辛
mainEntity.description: 辛 — pungent; a sharp, spicy-hot aromatic quality, the classical '味辛' of spices and resins (香乘: 辛辣之气).

mainEntity.name: 凉
mainEntity.description: 凉 — cooling; a cold, minty sensation in the nose, associated with borneol (龙脑) and camphor (樟脑).

mainEntity.name: 厚
mainEntity.description: 厚 — thick / full-bodied; a dense, rich, substantial scent character, the opposite of 薄 (香乘: 味厚 / 结实厚).

mainEntity.name: 薄
mainEntity.description: 薄 — thin / light; a delicate, faint scent character (香乘: 香味亦浅薄 'the fragrance is also thin/light').

mainEntity.name: 醇
mainEntity.description: 醇 — mellow / rich; a smooth, well-rounded, matured scent character (香乘 uses 淳醇 for a full, aged aroma).

mainEntity.name: 雅
mainEntity.description: 雅 — refined / elegant; an understated, cultured fragrance character prized in literati incense appreciation.

mainEntity.name: 前调
mainEntity.description: 前调 — top note; the modern perfumery term for the first, most volatile scent phase, parallel to the classical 头香.

mainEntity.name: 中调
mainEntity.description: 中调 — middle / heart note; the sustained central phase of a fragrance, parallel to the classical 本香.

mainEntity.name: 后调
mainEntity.description: 后调 — base note; the slow, lasting final phase of a fragrance, parallel to the classical 尾香.

mainEntity.name: 发烟量
mainEntity.description: 发烟量 — smoke output; how much visible smoke an incense emits when burned, a key format and comparison variable.

mainEntity.name: 燃烧速率
mainEntity.description: 燃烧速率 — burn rate; how fast an incense smolders, set by thickness, density, binder ratio, and moisture.

mainEntity.name: 断火
mainEntity.description: 断火 — self-extinguishing; a stick that smolders too slowly or goes out mid-burn, treated as a quality-control defect.

mainEntity.name: 香精
mainEntity.description: 香精 — fragrance oil; a manufactured scent concentrate (often synthetic) applied to a neutral base, distinct from essential oil (精油).

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Not the same as 精油 (essential oil); 香精 is a manufactured, often synthetic concentrate

mainEntity.name: 扩香
mainEntity.description: 扩香 — scent diffusion / throw; how far and how strongly a scent projects into a room.

mainEntity.name: 留香
mainEntity.description: 留香 — longevity / tenacity; how long a scent persists after burning, or on skin and fabric.

mainEntity.name: 定香剂
mainEntity.description: 定香剂 — fixative; a material that slows the evaporation of volatile notes and stabilizes a blend's structure.

mainEntity.name: 詹糖香
mainEntity.description: 詹糖香 — a classical aromatic listed in 香譜; 本草 records it from 晋安, 岑州, and south of 交广.

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 波律香
mainEntity.description: 波律香 — a classical aromatic from the kingdom of Polu, from the same tree as borneol (龙脑), per 香譜 citing 本草拾遗.

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 迷迭香
mainEntity.description: 迷迭香 — rosemary; 香譜 records it from the Western Regions, with an ode by Emperor Wen of Wei.

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 都梁香
mainEntity.description: 都梁香 — a classical aromatic named for Duling County, recorded in 香譜 via 荆州记.

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 紫檀
mainEntity.description: 紫檀 — red sandalwood (Pterocarpus santalinus), a crimson dye-and-carving wood, unrelated to true sandalwood (檀香, Santalum album).

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Shares the character 檀 with 檀香 but is a different plant, a dye wood not an incense heartwood

mainEntity.name: 樟脑
mainEntity.description: 樟脑 — camphor crystal; the distilled crystalline extract of the camphor laurel (樟木, Cinnamomum camphora), distinct from borneol (龙脑).

mainEntity.name: 藏香
mainEntity.description: 藏香 — Tibetan incense; thick, coreless, herbal-blend sticks rooted in Tibetan medicine (Sowa Rigpa) and monastery ritual.

mainEntity.name: 木香花
mainEntity.description: 木香花 — Banksia rose (Rosa banksiae), a sweet honeyed floral; its name is easily confused with 木香 (costus root).

mainEntity.name: 白檀
mainEntity.description: 白檀 — white sandalwood; usually specifies Santalum album among the Santalum species, distinguishing it from substitute species.

mainEntity.name: 香饼
mainEntity.description: 香饼 — incense cake; a pressed, hardened cake of blended incense powder and binder, burned whole on a censer. 香譜 lists 造香饼子法 'the method for making incense cakes' as a distinct form.

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 香膏
mainEntity.description: 香膏 — aromatic ointment; the oily, resinous balsam extracted from a resin such as storax, prized as the genuinely aromatic fraction and kept apart from the spent woody residue (大秦国人采得苏合香先煎其汁以为香膏 'the Daqin people first decoct the storax to take its juice as fragrant ointment').

mainEntity.name: 薰衣
mainEntity.description: 薰衣 — clothes fumigation; scenting garments by exposing them to incense smoke or storing them with scented material. 香譜 records 蜀王薰御衣法 'the Shu king's method of fumigating royal clothes' and the 衣香法 'clothes-scenting method'.

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Not 薰衣草 (xūnyīcǎo, lavender); 薰衣 is the classical practice of scenting garments

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 衣香
mainEntity.description: 衣香 — clothes-scenting incense; the wearable sachet and garment-perfume genre, as distinct from burned 合香. 香乘 records 南阳公主熏衣香 (Princess Nanyang's clothes-scenting incense) and the inner-court sachet 内苑蕊心衣香.

mainEntity.name: 食用级
mainEntity.description: 食用级 — food-grade; a market and quality grade for materials cleared for food and drink, as distinct from an incense-grade supply. Entity buyer sections flag food-grade material (chenpi, chrysanthemum) while noting incense combustion produces smoke and particulate.

additionalProperty.name: Usage
additionalProperty.value: Modern trade terminology; appears in entity-page buyer sections as 'food-grade'

mainEntity.name: 香用级
mainEntity.description: 香用级 — incense-grade; a market and quality grade for material destined for incense use, valued differently from the tea-grade or food-grade market (chrysanthemum: 'tea-grade and incense-grade markets value the flower differently').

additionalProperty.name: Usage
additionalProperty.value: Modern trade terminology; appears in entity-page buyer sections as 'incense-grade'

mainEntity.name: 木香
mainEntity.description: 木香 — costus root (Saussurea costus, syn. Dolomiaea costus / Aucklandia lappa); a classical Himalayan incense root with a deep, earthy, slightly musky-animalic fixative character. Not to be confused with 木香花 (Banksia rose) or 白木香 (Aquilaria sinensis).

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Shares 木香 with 木香花 (Banksia rose) and 白木香 (Aquilaria sinensis) but is a different plant

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 郁金
mainEntity.description: 郁金 — aromatic turmeric (Curcuma aromatica), the ginger-family rhizome behind the classical aromatic 鬱金香; the name literally means 'aromatic gold'. Distinct from the modern tulip 郁金香 and from culinary 姜黄 (Curcuma longa).

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: The same two characters 郁金香 also name the tulip; the classical aromatic is the Curcuma rhizome

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 艾纳香
mainEntity.description: 艾纳香 — Blumea balsamifera (sambong / Ngai camphor), the aromatic shrub whose leaves are the source of leaf-distilled l-borneol (艾片). 香譜 records it as 艾蒳香, and 本草纲目 notes its use 'to blend the many aromatics'.

sources.title: 香譜 (Hong Chu's Incense Manual) on Wikisource

mainEntity.name: 白胶香
mainEntity.description: 白胶香 — 'white-gum fragrance,' the classical name for sweetgum resin 枫香脂 (Liquidambar formosana), recorded in 香乘 and rendered in the Golden Light Sutra in transliteration as 须萨析罗婆.

mainEntity.name: 当归
mainEntity.description: 当归 — dong quai (Angelica sinensis), a famous materia-medica root and 香囊 sachet herb with a warm, sweet, herbal scent. Same genus, different species from 白芷 (Angelica dahurica); the shared English 'angelica' hides the distinction.

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Distinct from 白芷 (Angelica dahurica); both translate to 'angelica' in English

mainEntity.name: 灵猫香
mainEntity.description: 灵猫香 — civet; the glandular secretion of the civet (Civettictis civetta / Viverricula indica), an animal-derived fixative with an animalic, musky, sweet-warm scent, largely replaced in modern perfumery by synthetic civetone.

mainEntity.name: 海狸香
mainEntity.description: 海狸香 — castoreum; the scent secretion of the beaver (Castor fiber / C. canadensis), a Western classical perfumery fixative with no Chinese incense role, now almost entirely synthetic.

mainEntity.name: 紫草茸
mainEntity.description: 紫草茸 — shellac / lac resin; the insect-derived resinous secretion of the lac insect (Kerria lacca), a functional binder and historical red dye (classical 紫鉚/紫矿). Despite the herbal-sounding name, it is not a plant material.

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Name suggests a herb but it is an insect-derived resin

mainEntity.name: 秘鲁香脂
mainEntity.description: 秘鲁香脂 — Peru balsam (Myroxylon balsamum), a sweet, vanilla-like legume resin used in Western perfumery as a fixative and sweetener; a modern crossover with no classical Chinese incense origin.

mainEntity.name: 阿魏
mainEntity.description: 阿魏 — asafoetida (Ferula assa-foetida), a fiercely pungent, sulfurous resin of the carrot family (Apiaceae) that entered China via the Silk Road; its raw garlic-onion odor mellows on heating into an allium-like depth.

mainEntity.name: 白及
mainEntity.description: 白及 — bletilla (Bletilla striata), a mucilaginous orchid tuber used as a water-soluble binder that holds incense powders together; valued for function, not fragrance.

mainEntity.name: 罗勒
mainEntity.description: 罗勒 — basil (Ocimum basilicum), a mint-family culinary herb whose older Chinese name is 兰香 ('orchid fragrance'), a taboo-name substitution recorded in 本草纲目.

mainEntity.name: 砂仁
mainEntity.description: 砂仁 — amomum villosum (syn. Wurfbainia villosa), a ginger-family spice fruit used as a warm, camphoraceous 香药 accent in blended incense; 香乘 records it in the 南阳公主熏衣香 recipe.

mainEntity.name: 山柰
mainEntity.description: 山柰 — sand ginger / kencur (Kaempferia galanga), a ginger-family rhizome used as a pungent, camphoraceous spice; not common ginger (生姜, Zingiber officinale).
